method.access: Opened cited sources with web tools; exact read scope is per record. Search snippets alone did not establish a reading claim.
method.date_policy: Record original publication or delivery separately from edition, host, update and retrieval dates. Unknown is null.
method.authorship_policy: Attribution and institutional provenance are evidence, not forensic authorship proof. Date alone is insufficient.
method.copyright_policy: No copyrighted full text stored. Verbatim benchmark quotations limited to at most 25 words per distinct webpage across this package.
method.confidence: Qualitative provenance/observation confidence; not measured reader benefit.
method.profile_rule: Only profile_eligible true records can support canon principles; heldout source documents must never be used for profile or rule tuning.
